samples.question: The image has two panels separated by a horizontal black rule. The upper panel shows a TEMPLATE of 3 gray bars. The lower panel shows a TRACK of 9 gray bars. All bars have the same width and spacing and are drawn at the same vertical scale, each panel's bars standing on that panel's baseline. Directly above every track bar there is one colored flag (a small square). Exactly one run of 3 consecutive track bars has heights equal, bar for bar in left-to-right order, to the 3 template bars. Report the color of the flag above the track bar immediately to the RIGHT of that matching run (the 4th bar counting from the start of the run). Answer with exactly one of: crimson, amber, teal, violet.
